correctness.rationale: PASS. The specified deterministic Mime+SGD control variate for a quadratic f_i(y)=1/2 y^T H_i y-q_i^T y reduces exactly to g_i(y)=H_i(y-x)+c, where c is the broadcast full gradient. The first two local iterates average as x−kηc+binom(k,2)η² Hbar c for k=1,2, identical to two centralized GD steps. At k=3 the noncommuting-matrix expansion leaves only −η³[(1/m)Σ_i H_i²−Hbar²]c=−η³[(1/m)Σ_i(H_i−Hbar)²]c. Each H_i symmetric, so c^T(average−center)=−η³/m Σ_i||(H_i−Hbar)c||²≤0 (for η>0). The assertion is gradient-aligned, not an unconditional improvement in objective. Direct exact rational 2x2 noncommuting test agrees; a scalar two-client example yields central 64/125 and Mime 51/100 after step 3, defect −1/500. All equalities are polynomial identities valid regardless of convexity beyond the source's symmetric-quadratic hypothesis. No finite experiment was mistaken for proof.
